title: Reported Speech: Statements (said / told)
grammarTitle: Reported Speech — Statements: said and told
grammarNote: Косвенная речь (Reported Speech) используется для передачи того, что сказал кто-то другой — без использования его точных слов. Главное правило: времена СДВИГАЮТСЯ НАЗАД ("backshift"). Present Simple → Past Simple; Present Continuous → Past Continuous; will → would; can → could; have/has → had и т.д. Также меняются местоимения и указательные слова (this → that, here → there, tomorrow → the next day).

grammarTable.subject: Direct → Reported
grammarTable.example: "I study hard." → He said (that) HE STUDIED hard.

grammarTable.subject: Continuous backshift
grammarTable.example: "I'm working." → She said she WAS WORKING.

grammarTable.subject: Perfect backshift
grammarTable.example: "I've finished." → He said he HAD FINISHED.

grammarTable.subject: Future backshift
grammarTable.example: "I'll help." → She said she WOULD HELP.

grammarTable.subject: Modal backshift
grammarTable.example: "I can come." → He said he COULD COME. "I may be late." → She said she MIGHT BE LATE.

grammarTable.subject: said vs told
grammarTable.example: "He said (that)..." / "He told me (that)..." — told needs a person!

rows.example: "I work here." → She said she WORKED there.
"I'm studying." → He said he WAS STUDYING.
"I've finished." → She said she HAD FINISHED.
"I went." → He said he HAD GONE.
"I'll call." → She said she WOULD CALL.
"I can help." → He said he COULD HELP.

grammarExtra.title: said vs told — an essential distinction

rows.example: "He said (that) language changes." ✅ NOT "He said me that..."
"He told ME (that) language changes." / "She told US to read Aitmatov." ✅
✗ "He said me it was interesting." → ✅ "He told me it was interesting." OR "He said it was interesting." ✅
"He told me to come to his office." / "She told us to read the book." ✅
"I love this." → She said she loved IT.
"This is my book." → She said it was HER book.
"Come here." → He told me to go THERE.
"I like this place." → He said he liked THAT place.
"I'm busy now." → She said she was busy THEN.

rows.form: today → that day / tomorrow → next day
rows.example: "Meet me tomorrow." → He said to meet him THE NEXT DAY.

rows.form: If the situation is still true NOW
rows.example: "The Earth orbits the sun." → She said the Earth orbits the sun. (still true!)
"She says she's coming." (very recent — present still works)
"He says he works hard." (he says = present → no need to backshift)
"He said Aitmatov was a great writer." (was OR is — both acceptable)

grammarTip:
Reported Speech — три главных правила:
① Времена сдвигаются НАЗАД:
Present → Past, will → would, can → could, have → had
② SAY vs TELL:
"said" = без объекта: "He said (that)..."
"told" = с объектом: "He told ME (that)..."
✗ "He said me" — НИКОГДА!
③ Меняются местоимения и указательные слова:
"I" → he/she, "here" → there, "now" → then, "tomorrow" → the next day

💡 Слово "that" после said/told — НЕОБЯЗАТЕЛЬНО:
"She said (that) she was coming." ✅
"She said she was coming." ✅ — оба правильны!

⚠️ Факты, всегда истинные → сдвиг не нужен:
"She said water BOILS at 100°C." (не "boiled")

exercises.hint: Backshift: Present Simple → Past Simple. "I study" → "she STUDIED linguistics." ✅

exercises.text: "I'm working on the essay." → He said he ___ on the essay.
exercises.hint: Backshift: Present Continuous → Past Continuous. "I'm working" → "he WAS WORKING." ✅

exercises.text: Professor Aidarov ___ us to read Aitmatov.
exercises.hint: "told" + person (us) + to + infinitive. "He TOLD US to read Aitmatov." ✅ (NOT "said us")

exercises.text: "I'll help you." → She said she ___ help.
exercises.hint: Backshift: will → would. "I'll help" → "she said she WOULD HELP." ✅

exercises.text: "He said me that language never changes." — What is wrong?
exercises.hint: ✅ "He TOLD ME that language never changes." — "said" cannot have a person object! Use "told + person". ✅

exercises.text: "My research is on Kazakh." → She said ___ research was on Kazakh.
exercises.hint: Pronoun change: "my" (her speaking) → "her" (reporting about her). "She said HER research was on Kazakh." ✅

exercises.text: "I can come to the office." → He said he ___ come to the office.
exercises.hint: Backshift: can → could. "He said he COULD come to the office." ✅

exercises.text: "Meet me tomorrow." → He told her to meet him ___.
exercises.hint: "tomorrow" → "the next day" in reported speech. "He told her to meet him THE NEXT DAY." ✅

exercises.text: "I've finished the assignment." → She said she ___ the assignment.
exercises.hint: Backshift: Present Perfect → Past Perfect. "I've finished" → "she said she HAD FINISHED." ✅

exercises.text: "Water freezes at 0°C." → He said water ___ at 0°C. (scientific fact)
exercises.hint: Scientific/permanent facts: backshift is NOT needed. "He said water FREEZES at 0°C." ✅ (still true)

exercises.text: "I'm here right now." → She said she was ___ ___.
exercises.hint: "here" → "there" and "now" → "then" in reported speech. "She said she was THERE THEN." ✅

exercises.text: Professor Aidarov ___ that the project was competitive. He ___ us to apply anyway.
exercises.hint: "said" (no person object) / "told us" (with person object + to + inf). "He SAID... He TOLD US." ✅

questions.hint: Backshift: works → worked. "here" → "there". "She said she WORKED THERE." ✅
Backshift: am/is/are + -ing → was/were + -ing. "He said he WAS STUDYING." ✅

questions.text: "I'll call you." → She said she ___ call.
questions.hint: Backshift: will → would. "She said she WOULD CALL." ✅
"told + person + to + inf" = command. "He TOLD ME to read..." ✅ "said" cannot have a person object!

questions.text: "I can help." → He said he ___ help.
questions.hint: Backshift: can → could. "He said he COULD help." ✅
Backshift: Present Perfect → Past Perfect. "She said she HAD FINISHED." ✅

questions.text: "He said me it was interesting." is correct.
questions.hint: ✅ "He TOLD ME it was interesting." OR "He SAID it was interesting." Never "said me"!

questions.text: "My name is Kamila." → She said ___ name was Kamila.
questions.hint: Pronoun change: "my" → "her" (we are reporting about her). "She said HER name was Kamila." ✅

questions.text: "Meet me here tomorrow." → He told her to meet him ___ ___ .
"The Earth orbits the sun." → She said the Earth ___ the sun. (fact)
questions.hint: Scientific/permanent fact → NO backshift needed. "She said the Earth ORBITS the sun." ✅

questions.text: "I may be late." → He said he ___ be late.
questions.hint: Backshift: may → might. "He said he MIGHT be late." ✅

questions.text: "I'm going to apply." → She said she ___ apply.
questions.hint: Backshift: am going to → was going to. "She said she WAS GOING TO APPLY." ✅
"She said (THAT) she was coming." — "that" is optional and often omitted in spoken English. ✅

questions.text: "I went to Almaty." → She said she ___ to Almaty.
questions.hint: Backshift: Past Simple → Past Perfect. "She said she HAD GONE to Almaty." ✅

questions.text: "This is interesting." → He said ___ was interesting.
questions.hint: "this" → "that" in reported speech. "He said THAT was interesting." ✅

questions.text: Which sentence is in correct reported speech?
questions.hint: "said" + no person object. "She SAID she was tired." ✅ (Not "said me" or "told that")
